items.text: Key Choice have built a new extension on piled foundations for us, comprising an extended bedroom, new ensuite bathroom, new utility room and outdoor patio. We are very pleased with the result.

items.text: Working with Key Choice builders was a great experience. Gareth and his team are very responsive and always keep you in the loop.

faqs.a: Use the quote form on this page or call 07984 434396. A few photos of the job help us give you an accurate price.
